---
title: "Groups overview: the 18 CKAN groups and the single fetcher"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment  = "#>"
)
```

The CVM publishes its open data in **18 thematic groups** on the
CKAN portal at `<https://dados.cvm.gov.br/group/>`. `cvmdata` serves
every group through **one function**, `cvm_fetch()`: the dataset's
schema YAML tells the package which columns identify the entity
(issuer CNPJ today; fund CNPJ, registered-agent id, offering number
or event id as those groups arrive) and how the data is partitioned
in time, so the same arguments work across groups. The decision for
the single function is in
`data-raw/decisions/cvmdata_v0-3_funcao_unica_decisao.md`; the group
taxonomy and its contracts come from
`data-raw/decisions/cvmdata_arquitetura_grupos_decisao_v2.md` §1.1
(the rest of that document is historical); this article is the
navigation map.

Today only the `companhias` group is implemented. The others are
scheduled on the roadmap (funds from v0.4, agents and public
offerings in v0.7, regulatory events in v0.8) and will extend
`cvm_fetch()` through their own schemas, not through new fetchers.

```{r setup}
library(cvmdata)
```

## The 18 groups

```{r groups-table}
cvm_groups()
```

The `n_datasets` column counts datasets published by CVM, not the
count currently implemented in the package. The `contract` column is
a planning map: it names the kind of entity each group is keyed on
(`issuer`, `fund`, `agent`, `offering`, `event`), which is what
decides how `cvm_fetch()` will identify rows once the group ships.

```{r groups-by-contract}
g <- cvm_groups()
split(g$group, g$contract)
```

## Issuers — implemented

Covers **issuers** of securities: companies (`companhias`),
securitisation vehicles (`securitizadoras`), and CEPAC issuers
(`emissores-de-cepac`). v0.1 shipped the four core `companhias`
datasets: `cad`, `dfp`, `itr`, `fre`. v0.2 added `cgvn` (Brazilian
Corporate Governance Code informe), `vlmo` (securities traded and
held by insiders), `fca` (registration form, which also backs the
B3 ticker lookup) and `ipe` (manifest of periodic and eventual
documents). `recompra_acoes` (share buyback programs) followed — nine
`companhias` datasets in all.

The identity key is the issuer's CNPJ, selected with `cnpj` or,
through the registration form, with a B3 `ticker`. The temporal axis
is annual (with quarterly via ITR), selected with `year` or a
`from`/`to` window on the reference date, and the `basis` argument
selects individual/consolidated variants for accounting tables.

```{r issuer-example, eval = FALSE}
# Companies registry (no time partitioning, no basis)
issuers <- cvm_fetch("cad", "companhias")

# DFP balance sheet, individual, one year, one issuer
bb <- cvm_fetch(
  "dfp", "bpa",
  cnpj = "00.000.000/0001-91",
  year = 2024,
  basis = "ind"
)
```

## Funds, agents, offerings, events — on the roadmap

* **Funds** (v0.4–v0.6): `fundos-de-investimento` (ICVM 555),
  `fundos-de-investimento-imobiliarios` (FII) and
  `fundos-estruturados` (FIP, FIDC, FAPI). Keyed on the fund's CNPJ;
  monthly or quarterly depending on the dataset.
* **Registered agents** (v0.7): the eight agent-registry groups,
  from `administradores` to `investidores-nao-residentes`. Keys range
  from CNPJ (broker-dealers, audit firms) to dataset-specific
  registration numbers; the CVM publishes no CPF, so a filter for
  natural persons is still an open decision.
* **Public offerings** (v0.7): `ofertas-publicas` and
  `plataformas-de-crowdfunding` (Resolução CVM 88). Keyed on the
  offering number; a date window is the natural slice.
* **Regulatory events** (v0.8): `atividade-sancionadora` and
  `atos-declaratorios`. Keyed on the process or act id.

Each of these lands as schema YAMLs under the group's slug; the
`cvm_fetch()` signature does not change.

## Discovery functions accept `group`

When the same `(dataset, table)` pair lives in more than one group
(a v0.4+ possibility once `fund` datasets enter), the discovery
functions resolve by uniqueness when `group` is omitted, and abort
with `cvmdata_error_input_ambiguous` when it cannot disambiguate.
Pass `group` explicitly to skip the lookup:

```{r discovery-with-group}
cvm_datasets(group = "companhias")
cvm_tables("dfp", group = "companhias")
```

The `group` argument is optional on `cvm_datasets()`, `cvm_tables()`,
`cvm_dictionary()`, `cvm_codelist()`, and `cvm_dataset_years()`. The
returned `cvm_tbl` from `cvm_fetch()` also carries `group` as a
provenance attribute (`attr(x, "group")`), and `print.cvm_tbl()`
renders it in the header.
